'''Moria Karentanis''' was an [[Aes Sedai]] [[Sitter]] of the [[Blue Ajah]], who was also secretly a member of the [[Black Ajah]].{{ref/book|twotc|Moria Karentanis}}

==Appearance==
Moria was ordinary and plain - so much so that the ageless look was not obvious. She was not considered graceful and had a thick accent. She wore plain blue wool.{{ref/book|10|19}}

==Strength and Abilities==
Moria is of [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|low average]] strength for an Aes Sedai with a [[One Power]] level of {{opsl|31}}. She would be unable to [[Traveling|Travel]] without linking with another channeler.

==History==
Moria was born in the year {{ne|840}} and went to the [[White Tower]] in {{ne|854}}. After spending eight years as [[Novice]] and seven as [[Accepted]] she was raised to the shawl in the year {{ne|861}}. She was raised a Sitter in {{ne|999}}, in [[Salidar]].

She was from [[Illian]] and had been Aes Sedai for over one hundred and thirty years. She was a tough woman that would balk at little if she believed it was necessary.{{ref/book|10|19}} [[Anaiya]] thought she could be harder, or at least tougher, than [[Lelaine]]. When Egwene discovered Moria was Black Ajah, she was shocked and a little saddened, as she had come to rely on Moria for support on many of her motions in the Hall.

==Activities==
She allied herself with the [[Rebel Aes Sedai]] and was elected as a [[Sitter]] to the [[Rebel Hall of the Tower]] to replace the Blue Sitter who had been killed in the Schism. She was not part of [[Lelaine]]'s faction, despite also being a Blue. She disliked the openness of the Schism, and wished there were some other way to fight against [[Elaida]].

She suggested stopping the soldiers' pay when the Rebel Aes Sedai ran into money troubles. This would have doubtless resulted in them losing their army.

She was one of only two Sitters newly elected to the Rebel Hall that was not [[Too Young Sitters|traditionally too young]] for the position, the other being [[Romanda Cassin]].{{ref/book|10|19}}

===Vote for War===
She voted yes on the Rebel Aes Sedai declaring war on [[Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan]]. Her open outburst at [[Lelaine Akashi]] caused her and [[Lyrelle]] to vote "yes" as well, resulting in a lesser consensus standing and a passed motion. Lelaine warned Moria that they would speak about proper decorum later on.

Later, [[Anaiya]], a member of [[Egwene al'Vere's Council|Egwene's Council]], commented that she is harder than Lelaine in some ways and laid the death of every single sister since the [[White Tower Schism|coup]] at Elaida's feet.{{ref/book|10|19}}

===Black Tower Alliance===
She, [[Malind Nachenin]], and [[Escaralde]] called a Sitting of the [[Hall]] to discuss the findings of the team of Aes Sedai that went to investigate the events at [[Battle near Shadar Logoth|Shadar Logoth]] during the [[Cleansing of saidin|cleansing of ''saidin'']]. These three Sitters were, in truth, seeking a vote on an agreement with the [[Black Tower]]. In response to the proposal to seek an agreement with the Black Tower, [[Magla Daronos]] shook her fist at Moria.{{ref/book|10|19}}

Moria escorted [[Merise Haindehl]] to the Rebel Hall as a representative of the [[Dragon Reborn]]. She stood to accept the offer from the Dragon Reborn of bonding forty-seven [[Asha'man]].

===Ties to Black Ajah===
[[Verin Mathwin]]'s notes on the [[Black Ajah]] named her as a member, which was subsequently confirmed at a meeting of the Rebel Hall. After Sheriam was revealed before the Hall, Moria tried to flee, but Egwene, who had anticipated her flight, stopped her. She was one of the fifty Black sisters executed in the rebel camp.
